title: On-ear (supra-aural) headphone: parametric design template (theory-only)
description: A 40 mm dynamic driver in an on-ear cup whose pad rests on the pinna. Modelled: a small front chamber between the driver and the compressed pinna, joined to the concha; the leak between pad and pinna as a thermoviscous slit, whose size is chosen as a fit state; a damping cloth over the driver's rear openings; behind it a closed rear cavity with meshed vents or an open grille; the ear load, the IEC 60318-4 simulator behind the ITU-T P.57 10 mm canal extension (the Type 3 ears; the pinna simulator is not modelled) or the P.57 Type 4.3 ear from its entrance point. With a small front volume the leak, not the cavity, sets the bass (spec Section 18). Anchors: driver defaults are the Tymphany HPD-40N16PET00-32 primary set (docs/spec-errata.md E5); the low- and high-leak states use the slit dimensions of the ITU-T P.57 Type 3.2 simplified pinna simulator, which P.57 recommends for supra-aural receivers and marks as guidance only (erratum E38); the concha volume is the mean of Burkhard and Sachs as quoted in US 8,638,963. Estimates: the pad, cup and rear geometry, the damping cloth and the vents. Not modelled: the pinna's own compliance and the pad's compression under clamp force, a porous pad path, the front chamber's transverse modes and diaphragm break-up. docs/templates.md gives the sources and what the defaults produce.

driver_diameter_mm.label: Effective diaphragm diameter
driver_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of a circle of area Sd; the cross-section draws the diaphragm this wide.

driver_Le_uH.label: Coil inductance Le
driver_Le_uH.description: Near zero for most headphone drivers (spec Section 4); a few hundred microhenries would falsely roll off the treble of a 32 ohm driver.

pad_inner_radius_mm.label: Pad inner radius
pad_inner_radius_mm.description: Radius of the pad's opening over the pinna, and of the front chamber (estimate).

front_depth_mm.label: Driver-to-pinna depth
front_depth_mm.description: Distance from the diaphragm to the compressed pinna: the pad's compressed height plus the baffle recess (estimate).

concha_volume_cm3.label: Concha volume
concha_volume_cm3.description: Concha cavity joined to the front chamber at the ear. Burkhard and Sachs measured a mean of 4.65 cm3 for men and 3.94 cm3 for women (SD 0.76 and 0.81), as quoted in US 8,638,963. With the Type 4.3 ear, 0.68 cm3 of the concha bottom is already part of the ear load.

tolerance.source: Burkhard and Sachs (2 SD), as quoted in US 8,638,963

front_volume_cm3.label: Front volume
front_volume_cm3.description: The cylinder under the pad plus the concha.

fit.label: Fit on the pinna
fit.description: The leak between pad and pinna. Low and high are the Type 3.2 simplified pinna simulator of ITU-T P.57 (06/2021), Table 3-a, for receivers held firmly or loosely: slits 0.26 mm high and 2.8 mm deep over 84 degrees (two 42 degree slits), and 0.50 mm high and 1.9 mm deep over 240 degrees. P.57 marks these dimensions as guidance only and derives them from telephone handsets (erratum E38). The slit breadth is the arc at mid-depth of a slit in the rim of the simulator's 25 mm cavity (P.57 Figure 6; this reading is ours).

custom_gap_mm.label: Custom slit height
custom_gap_mm.description: Used when the fit is Custom; the slit is as deep as the pad face is wide.

custom_breadth_mm.label: Custom slit breadth
custom_breadth_mm.description: Used when the fit is Custom: the length of pad edge that leaks.

pad_width_mm.label: Pad face width
pad_width_mm.description: Width of the pad where it rests on the pinna (estimate).

damping_rayl.label: Damping cloth behind the driver (0 = none)
damping_rayl.description: Specific flow resistance, MKS rayl, of the felt or non-woven cloth over the driver's rear openings, between the diaphragm and the rear cavity or grille. 600 rayl is the engineered-textile grade of the materials database (textile_acoustic_600, unverified); the value for a given product is not public.

tolerance.source: estimate (felt and non-woven; meshes are held to 10-15 %)

damping_area_cm2.label: Open area under the damping cloth
damping_area_cm2.description: Total area of the driver's rear openings that the cloth covers (estimate).

driver_back_volume_cm3.label: Air space behind the diaphragm
driver_back_volume_cm3.description: Volume between the diaphragm and the damping cloth, inside the driver frame (estimate).

cup_radius_mm.label: Cup radius
cup_radius_mm.description: The rear cup is drawn as wide as the pad's outer edge.

vent_mesh_rayl.label: Vent mesh resistance (0 = open hole)
vent_mesh_rayl.description: Specific flow resistance of a mesh covering each vent, MKS rayl (160 is the Saati Acoustex grade the spec cites).

grille_rayl.label: Open-back grille resistance
grille_rayl.description: Specific flow resistance of the grille and its fabric over the diaphragm area, MKS rayl (used when the back is open).

choices.label: IEC 60318-4 with the P.57 10 mm canal extension
ITU-T P.57 Type 4.3 ear from its entrance point

source_impedance_ohm.label: Amplifier output impedance
source_impedance_ohm.description: 0 ohm ideal, below 1 ohm portable, 10 ohm desktop, 120 ohm the legacy IEC 61938 figure.

drive_mW.label: Drive power into the rated impedance
drive_mW.description: Every level states its drive: this is the power into the rated impedance (1 mW is the usual sensitivity reference). Warnings such as vent velocity and excursion are checked at this drive.
